## Overview

Render configurable widgets from the command line.

Topics: `cli` `widgets`

Written primarily in TypeScript, Shell.

## Prerequisites

- Package manager: npm (lockfile package-lock.json) (source: `package.json`)
- Requires Node.js >=20 (source: `package.json`)

## Installation

```sh
npm install --global @acme/widget
```

## Usage

```sh
widget render --config widget.config.json
```

## Configuration

Example configuration is provided in:
